targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  board_slot, channel, channel_name, "timestamp",
  v0set, i0set, vmon, imon, pw
FROM (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY board_slot, channel ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC
  ) AS rn
  FROM public.e80_caenhv
  WHERE ip_address = '192.168.20.222'
    AND board_slot IN (2, 9)
) t
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY board_slot, channel;
